posts.author: caethyril
posts.body:
Your event seems to check the value of a variable named "Enemy HP". But variables only update their value when you tell them to, and Parallel/Autorun events do not run during battle.
So it looks like you need to add a command at the start of the event to store the current HP of Enemy #1 in that variable before its value is checked: Control Variables -> Set -> Game Data -> Enemy -> HP.
(You could also use Show Text commands to test which branches are actually running.)
Edit: I had a look at the code and it looks like Force Action will only pause the interpreter until the action has started. So I think, without any delay after Enemy Transform, the battle will reliably end 2 frames afterwards? (1 to start the troop event, 1 to finish the stuff after Force Action.) Like Harlekin etc have suggested, try adding wait time or something equivalent (e.g. Show Battle Animation with "Wait for Completion", or Show Text) after the transformation.
